result.instructions: Trammel plans multi-file changes in dependency order and keeps plans, constraints, failures and recipes in .trammel/ so later sessions and other agents can pick work up. Worth it when several files must change in order or work is handed between agents; for a one- or two-file edit, just edit. Name the files in the goal (or pass files) and the plan starts from them. Loop: get_constraints and get_recipe, start_plan, then per step verify_step (tests run on a kept copy with its own build cache; background: true and job_status for long runs), then complete_plan. To hand off, add_note what you did and what is left; the next agent calls get_plan with the plan_id and reads the notes. TRAMMEL_MCP_SURFACE=all adds claim_step, available_steps and record_steps for several agents on one plan.

tools.description: Plan a change that spans several files and save it. Use it when the files must change in dependency order, or when another agent or a later session will continue the work (get_plan, add_note). Skip it for a one- or two-file edit you can make now. Name the files in the goal or pass files: the plan starts from them, adds a few direct dependencies, dependents and tests ranked below them, and lists code before tests, each step with a role. Without named files it ranks the whole repo by goal words (15 files). Returns plan_id.

tools.name: status

tools.description: Run the tests against edits in a copy of the project; the real tree is never touched. Use it to check an edit before writing it, or when other agents share your working tree; if you can just run the tests yourself, do that. The copy and its cargo target dir are kept per project, so later runs rebuild only what changed. Unbalanced brackets fail at once with line numbers. A timeout answers timed_out with elapsed_s and how to raise timeout_s. Long runs: background: true returns a job_id at once; poll job_status. Output capped at 4 KB.

background.description: Return a job_id at once and run in the background (up to 3600 s); read the result with job_status. Needs the MCP server.

edits.description: Files to write in the copy: [{path, content}], content is the whole new file.

full_output.description: Return the whole test output instead of 4 KB head and tail.

language.description: Override language detection for the default test command.

project_root.description: Project directory. Default: the server's working directory.

test_cmd.description: Test command as a string or argv array. Default: .trammel.json test_cmd, else the language default (python -m unittest, cargo test, npm test, go test ./...).

timeout_s.description: Seconds the test command may run. Default: verify_timeout_s in .trammel.json, else 300. A call that waits is capped at 600; with background: true, 3600.
